original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 3 Power Supply State metadata for the intended enclosure matches the approved normal-state enumeration and persists after reboot. The trailing phrase denotes the chassis-status field group, not a separate status value or live PSU health test.
original_method: Capture full Type 3 records, select the enclosure through protected identity/BOM fields, parse raw and decoded Power Supply State, compare with the approved metadata baseline, reboot and repeat without removing AC or injecting a PSU fault.
manual_activity: A user approves the canonical field mapping, expected enum and reboot plan. The metadata read and persistence comparison are software-controlled.
required_inputs: Approved source-hierarchy to Power Supply State mapping
Expected raw/decoded Type 3 Power Supply State
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not remove AC, disable a PSU, inject faults or change firmware under this case.
Preserve complete Type 3 output and raw enum; reject literal concatenated-label filtering as proof.
Do not confuse static Type 3 metadata with BMC/PSU live telemetry or redundancy status.
Do not invent a second generic Chassis Status value; reject reserved/out-of-range enums and wrong-enclosure records.
Stop on ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 structures, select the enclosure, parse canonical Power Supply State and compare raw/decoded values before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate power, claim live PSU fault coverage, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field semantics, expected metadata enum and enclosure mapping.
Decide whether separate live PSU/redundancy testing is required and issue the metadata-case verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable as an authoritative extractor because the full descriptive phrase is not the canonical output label; errors and record/enum provenance are also lost.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the original phrase as provenance, archive complete Type 3 output/tool/errors and parse only record-scoped canonical `Power Supply State` with its raw enum.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source hierarchy, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained verbatim.

modernized_recommendation.status: STATIC TYPE 3 POWER-SUPPLY STATE ENUM CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the item hierarchy to one canonical Type 3 enum, retain raw and decoded values for the mapped enclosure and compare across reboot while explicitly excluding live PSU fault/redundancy behavior.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 System Enclosure or Chassis States enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects extraction, defines a single field and prevents unsafe expansion into power manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction to metadata coverage; live PSU behavior remains separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A static firmware field may not reflect current PSU redundancy or fault telemetry.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific normal/unknown enum, but must retain raw evidence and cannot substitute BMC telemetry or physical PSU removal for this metadata field without a separate approved case.
expected_evidence: Approval, canonical mapping, expected Power Supply State enum, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 record plus raw/decoded power-state comparison
Engineer verdict and separate live-PSU coverage reference if applicable
